name: proto-blocks/oit-two-col-header
title: OIT Two-Col Header
description: Industry / section page header. Auto-derived breadcrumb, industry icon above headline, supporting subtitle, large featured image on the right, giant background wordmark, and a scroll-triggered reveal. Light theme only.

wordmark.label: Background Wordmark
wordmark.help: Giant uppercase word that sits behind the layout. Leave empty to hide.

highlightWord.label: Highlight word/phrase in title
highlightWord.help: First case-insensitive occurrence in the title is wrapped in a red span.

showIcon.label: Show industry icon
showIcon.help: Off hides the icon (and its placeholder) entirely — useful for variants that lead with the title.

removeShadow.label: Remove image red glow
removeShadow.help: Off keeps the shadow-red-glow on the featured image (existing behavior). On removes it for a flatter look.

centerText.label: Center text vertically with image
centerText.help: Pair with Show industry icon = off when the left column is shorter than the image, so the text sits centered against the image instead of pinned to the top.

smallSubtitle.label: Subtitle: small font size (16px)
smallSubtitle.help: Off keeps the default 16/20 px responsive size. On locks the subtitle to 16px at every breakpoint.
